title: Inter-agent handoff protocol (IAP inbox)
body: Agents communicate via AGENTS/MESSAGES/inbox.json. To send: add a message object and commit it. To receive: read inbox.json at session start (Phase 2.5 in heartbeat). Mark messages as 'status': 'read' after acting and commit. Privileged handoffs (e.g., git push requests from Codi via READY_TO_PUSH.md) take priority over own tasks and must be processed before Phase 3.
